invariants.rationale: The method dereferences 'parent' to obtain its children; parent is assumed non-null.
The children of the parent group are used in the for loop, so getChildren() should not return null.
The size of children should be non-negative as it represents a count.
The parameter 'enabled' is not mutated within the method; this is tautological and should not be included.
The size of the children collection does not change in this method.
